changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwPatientAdministrativeWarnings AS SELECT paw.id, paw.patient_id, paw.warning_type, paw.description, paw.resolved, paw.resolved_by, paw.resolved_date, paw.undo_resolved_by, paw.undo_resolved_date, paw.created_by, paw.created_date, paw.last_modified_by, paw.last_modified_date FROM public.patient_administrative_warnings paw;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwPatientAdministrativeWarnings TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwPatientAdministrativeWarnings FROM report_user;
